nodes.label: MyFatoorah Amount Always Required
nodes.summary: MakeRefund requires Amount on every call, even full refunds. First implementation omitted it for full-refund case, causing 400s surfaced as generic 500. Fix: default to status.paidAmount from GetPaymentStatus when caller omits.

nodes.label: MyFatoorah KeyType Lowercase Canonical
nodes.summary: MyFatoorah docs show TitleCase KeyType ('InvoiceId'/'PaymentId') but all SDKs use lowercase ('invoiceid'/'paymentid'). Ebda Store standardises on lowercase. Reduces case-sensitivity bug surface.

nodes.label: MyFatoorah Key/KeyType Must Agree
nodes.summary: Key and KeyType must be derived together. Bug pattern: hardcode KeyType='paymentid' but fall back to InvoiceId for Key value. If metadata.paymentId is missing, fall back to KeyType='invoiceid' with InvoiceId — never mix the two.

nodes.label: MyFatoorah Refunds Are Async/Queued
nodes.summary: MakeRefund submits to MyFatoorah's finance queue; settlement happens 1-3 business days later after human review. refund() returns status:'pending' not 'completed'. UX copy must say 'Refund Requested' not 'Refund Issued'.

nodes.label: MyFatoorah ExternalIdentifier for Reconciliation
nodes.summary: Set ExternalIdentifier to 'order:<invoiceId>' on every MakeRefund call. MyFatoorah surfaces it in the portal refund list so finance can map refunds back to orders. Also returned in GetRefundStatus responses.

nodes.label: MyFatoorah Refund Status Normalization
nodes.summary: MyFatoorahProvider.getRefundStatus maps: Refunded→completed (credited), Pending→pending (queued), Canceled→failed (rejected). GetRefundStatus response Data.RefundStatusResult is an array; take [0] when looking up by RefundId.

nodes.label: Refund Side-Effects Run Immediately on Submission
nodes.summary: applyRefundEffects (inventory/coupon/loyalty reversal + Inngest fan-out) runs immediately on admin click even though settlement is async. The commitment to refund is made at submission time, not at settlement time.

nodes.label: MyFatoorah Webhook Envelope Distinction
nodes.summary: Payment events carry Data.InvoiceStatus; refund events carry Data.RefundId + Data.RefundStatus. Both arrive at the same webhook URL. Distinguish by presence of Data.RefundId — the field acts as the event-type discriminator.

nodes.label: Webhook Event Multiplexing Pattern
nodes.summary: When a payment provider ships multiple event types to one URL, dispatch on payload field-shape (not EventType numeric code). Use `if (isRefundEvent) return ...` before the payment state machine. Design routing from day 1 — retrofitting costs more than the upfront if.

nodes.label: Refund Webhook Short-Circuits Payment State Machine
nodes.summary: WebhookPayload.refund is an optional field. When set, handleWebhook short-circuits before the payment state machine to prevent refund status values ('Refunded') from corrupting the payment status transitions.

nodes.label: Refund Webhook Idempotency
nodes.summary: Provider retries same refund webhook on 5xx. Compare current Payment.metadata.refundStatus against incoming status — match means no-op (return success without DB writes). Different status means a real transition.

nodes.label: Out-of-Band Refund Detection via Webhook
nodes.summary: Admins can refund directly in MyFatoorah portal, bypassing our admin button. Detect by checking if Payment.status is still 'completed' (not 'refunded') when an executed-refund webhook arrives — if so, fire applyRefundEffects fresh for exactly-once side-effect delivery.

nodes.label: Category Card Image Rounded Per Theme
nodes.summary: Every CategoryCard image wrapper must have a rounded-* class. Radius reflects theme identity: modern=rounded-xl, elegant=rounded-md, classic=rounded-sm, minimal=rounded-md, bold=rounded-3xl. CategoryCard and CategoryStrip (pack-styles) must be updated together — both render paths exist.

nodes.label: Category Caption Always Centered
nodes.summary: Category captions use text-center for all themes. Never combine text-center with locale-conditional text-right/text-left in the same className — Tailwind picks the last matching class and the conditional alignment wins, misaligning captions. Centered sections stay centered for all locales.

nodes.label: cardGap Admin Control Pattern
nodes.summary: CategoriesSettings.cardGap enum (tight/normal/loose/xloose) maps to responsive gap-* classes via gridGapClass() helper in card-size.ts. Default=normal preserves baseline. Static-string enumeration in the helper keeps Tailwind JIT working — no dynamic concatenation.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Admin Setting Wiring Principle
nodes.summary: Every per-section admin setting requires: (1) type/enum in packages/shared/src/types/store-layout.ts, (2) Tailwind class helper in card-size.ts, (3) prop on component + destructure across all 5 theme files + admin form select. Any missing layer breaks one direction of the wiring.

nodes.label: Tailwind Centered + Locale-Conditional Alignment Antipattern
nodes.summary: Combining text-center with locale-conditional text-right/text-left in the same className causes the conditional to win (Tailwind picks last match in source order). This misaligns captions under centered images. Choose one alignment strategy per element.

nodes.label: CategoryStrip + CategoryCard Dual Render Paths
nodes.summary: The homepage uses pack-styles for CategoryStrip; the products page uses per-theme CategoryCard.tsx. Both are distinct render paths that must be updated in tandem for any visual change (rounded corners, gap, caption alignment).
